title: Audit a negative-log false certificate reaching the proof producer
body:
## Summary

The historical numerical helper accepts a negative logarithm upper bound and its actual proof producer emits a false inequality. At canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, `certify_network(46, 36, -1000)` reports `499001` as an exponential lower bound, and `make_patch.extended_files(36, 46, -1000)` emits `m < exp(-1000)` for `m = 97336`.

The missing premise is the sign of the Taylor-series argument: `1 - 1000 + 1000^2/2 = 499001`, while independently `exp(-1000) < 1`. The negative bound also makes both deficit comparisons vacuous.

This isolated package adds a bounded replay of the actual helper and six-file proof producer, an elementary sign proof, exact source pins and a two-line proposed positivity guard tested in memory. The guard rejects five nonpositive bounds before any proof file is yielded, preserves all three published positive helper certificates and all 18 proposed proof files, and retains rejection of an insufficient positive bound. Four Git-free CLI test groups cover normal/optimized replay, source corruption before execution, a forged adoption receipt and a weakened patch.

**The production guard is not adopted in this PR.** `research/rational-containment-performance` binds the helper as a frozen live input; `certificates/ternary-side.json` records its hash too. The package verifies these adoption dependencies and supplies a concrete successor/rebinding handoff. All production helpers, upstream files, frozen archives and selected-frontier metadata remain unchanged. No selected-result failure or new kappa is claimed.

## Test plan

- [x] Registered replay and exact source-pin validation.
- [x] Original false proof output reproduced; proposed guard preserves positive controls.
- [x] Four Git-free CLI test groups, including source/receipt/patch corruption.
- [x] Committed publication-byte comparison and whitespace checks.

Validation commands:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/network-log-domain-audit
python3 -I -B research/network-log-domain-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/network-log-domain-audit/verify.py
python3 -I -B research/network-log-domain-audit/test_verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/network-log-domain-audit --check-only
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/network-log-domain-audit
```

Registered replay passed on CPython 3.12.14; direct replay and four CLI tests also passed on CPython 3.11.6. Publication-byte comparison passed. The optional `--check-source-history` preflight refused this shallow local clone; every declared pin is at the canonical base commit, the direct parent of the contribution commit. Full selected cold replay and hosted CI are not claimed.

The `supplier-boundary-audit` scope is explicitly changed from the selected scatter task to this historical numerical-certificate/proof-producer boundary. Recent open-PR/discussion metadata, local package notes and targeted all-state PR searches found no matching correction; arbitrary diffs and unpublished work were not exhaustively searched.

Credit Douglas Colkitt and repository contributors for the retained helper and patch producer, and the authors of the pinned OpenAI integer-multiplication manuscript. Prepared for roger-sato with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; no independent human or proof-assistant review is claimed.
